sections.title: Introduction
sections.text: Sample Project is a tiny demo document for the DocuVoice narration script. It explains what the project does in a few spoken sentences.

sections.title: Install
sections.text: Install the project in three steps. First, clone the repository. Second, run npm install. Third, run npm run dev to start the local server.

sections.title: Configuration
sections.text: The server port comes from the PORT setting and defaults to three thousand. Start the app with npm run dev after dependencies are installed.

sections.title: Caution
sections.text: Note: the free ElevenLabs plan includes ten thousand credits per month. A long document can use a large share of that allowance.
